messages:
Sam (growth): Thinking about a micro-experiment for next launch: test 'prompt-template showcase' vs 'credit-drip over 3 days'. aim is to see which drives faster meaningful usage (not just signups). want quick thumbs.
Tori (content): love it. prompt-template idea: surface 4 curated templates on signup landing (chat, summarization, sales-email, code-debug). call-to-action: \"Try a template\" -> immediate first-gen.
Diego (data): define 'meaningful' plz. propose metric: percent of new accounts with >=1 API call that returns tokens and >=1 convo that uses a template within 48h. secondary: 7-day retention and avg tokens.
Nora (design): I can build a modular landing that toggles module A (templates grid) vs module B (credit drip CTA with microcopy). keep colors consistent. any brand copy constraints?
Sam (growth): keep voice simple. credit-drip copy: \"Claim $20 now, $15 after day1, $15 after day2\" — purpose is to nudge return visits. we'll cap at $1000/day.
Felix (dev): implementation note: we'll use exp param and set cohort cookie. also add a small JS to surface the templates inline (client-side) for cohort template_showcase. snippet: 
```
if (qs.exp === 'templates') showTemplateGrid();
else if (qs.exp === 'creditdrip') showCreditCTA();
```
Diego (data): sample size note: baseline meaningful metric ~8%. want to detect 3pp lift with 80% power -> ~18k visitors per arm. can run smaller pilot to sanity-check.
Tori (content): onboarding emails — should we sequence a follow-up for credit-drip to remind users on day2? that might confound. maybe hold email for now, rely on in-product notification.
Sam (growth): agreed hold email. but add in-app toast on day1 reminding them of next credit. will track toast_click event.
Nora (design): will prototype toast and inline template microcopy. linking to GitHub Gist with 3 example prompts for the code template.
Felix (dev): routing plan: utm + exp param -> set cookie exp_cohort. include exp_cohort in signup, credit allotment logic reads cohort. also will emit event experiment_cohort on first_gen.
OpsBot: CI job triggered: marketing-landing-featureAB (staging) by Felix  build 1.2.0
Diego (data): dashboard plan: cohort funnel (visit -> signup -> first_gen -> template_use/credit_redeem -> retention_7d). also add hazard alert if credit_redeem >> expected.
Sam (growth): timeline: creative by tomorrow noon, staging test tomorrow pm, launch Friday 10am PT, run 5 days for pilot. post-mortem Monday.
Tori (content): draft copy snippets: 
- Templates headline: \"Plug-and-play prompts to ship features faster\"
- Credit-drip headline: \"Start building today  split your $50 credits over 3 days\"
- CTA: \"Try a template\" / \"Claim credits\"
Diego (data): agree to monitor quality: pick 20 random first-gen responses per cohort for manual quality pass.
Nora (design): assets uploaded to drive: https://drive.company/redwood/marketing/templates-showcase.zip
Felix (dev): PR up for tracking + template render. staging link: https://staging.redwood.ai/ab-test?exp=templates
Sam (growth): good work. small ask: add a tiny checkbox on signup for \"I'm exploring infra/perf\" so we can segment folks who came for performance vs product use. optional and default unchecked.
Diego (data): fine, but treat as optional signal. will not be primary.
Sam (growth): launching Friday 10:00am PT. will do quick check at 11:30 for early signals. thanks team :sparkles:
